title: Пешеход заканчивает переход
adaptation: Signalised junction: south/north green for vehicles, east/west red. Zebra across the north arm. Red sedan at the south stop line with its fresh green, straight north. A pedestrian in a blue jacket who started earlier is past the middle of the zebra, in red's northbound lane, finishing west to east. Red moves only after he has reached the east sidewalk.
